title: American Ghostic
description: An affectionate parody of the famous American Gothic farmhouse portrait: a deadpan Space Ghost holds the pitchfork like a late-night interview microphone, while Zorak dressed in a prim Victorian collar looks intensely unimpressed beside him. The familiar steep farmhouse window contains one tiny glowing planet. Exquisite weathered wood, canvas brushwork and theatrical evening light.
prompt:
Create exactly one beautiful 16:10 landscape desktop wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600. It is an affectionate, funny Space Ghost parody in a painterly style with extraordinary detail, rich atmospheric depth, luminous highlights and beautiful canvas texture. Space Ghost is the recognizable animated superhero: muscular, white costume, black hood/mask, yellow cape, red power bands. Make the visual joke readable and charming without explanatory text. Preserve a spacious, quieter upper edge for a desktop panel. If a theme is supplied, follow its palette throughout; otherwise choose colors that suit the scene naturally. No UI, words, logos, watermarks or picture frames. Deliver the actual raster image using built-in native image generation; do not substitute code, SVG or a text description.

Theme: Gruvbox Dark. Gruvbox Dark color direction: warm charcoal and soot-black shadows (#282828, #1d2021), aged cream and parchment (#ebdbb2), glowing amber (#fabd2f), burnt orange (#fe8019), muted olive (#b8bb26), and restrained blue-grey (#83a598). Rich painterly canvas texture, cinematic chiaroscuro, luminous focal detail against calm dark negative space. Match a sophisticated warm dark desktop. Let Space Ghost's white suit read as aged ivory. Keep the scene funny, beautifully composed and legible at desktop scale. Avoid dominant purple or neon pink.
